subcategories.definition: Signs and hangers designed to be displayed on doors, including over-door hangers and door number/name signs.
subcategories.boundary: Use for items with 'door hanger' or 'door sign' in the description or clearly intended for a door (e.g. French blue metal door signs numbered 0-9/No); exclude general wall signs such as 'BATHROOM METAL SIGN' that can be used anywhere.

subcategories.definition: Decorative or novelty signs with printed text or motifs for wall or shelf display, including metal signs, calendar signs, and signs with single hooks.
subcategories.boundary: Use for non-door signs with wording or motifs; excludes chalkboards/memo boards and non-text decorative wall art. Calendar signs and cupcake single-hook signs stay here because the sign is the primary object.

subcategories.definition: Reusable writing/notice boards including blackboards, chalkboards and memo boards, with or without an easel.
subcategories.boundary: Use for plain writing surfaces; if the board is primarily a storage organiser with hooks/pockets, assign to wall_organisers (e.g. 5 hook blackboard organiser).

subcategories.definition: Wall-mounted organisers, tidies and storage boards with pockets, compartments or hooks for holding mail, CDs, papers or kitchen items.
subcategories.boundary: Use for items described as wall tidy, wall organiser or blackboard organiser with integrated storage; exclude plain chalkboards and decorative signs.

subcategories.definition: Decorative number tiles or plaques used to display house numbers or decorative numerals.
subcategories.boundary: Use for NUMBER TILE items in numeric series 0-9 and No; exclude French blue metal door signs (door_hangers_signs) and general wall signs.

subcategories.definition: Non-scripted decorative wall pieces and plaques, including mirrored wall art, pictorial plaques and decorative metal silhouettes.
subcategories.boundary: Use for items described as mirrored wall art, wall plaque, or decorative metal shapes without a sign/notice function; exclude all worded signs and chalkboards.

proposal.comment: The old signs_boards contained several distinct product types: door-related signs/hangers, wall signs, writing/memo boards, wall organisers, number tiles and decorative non-text wall art. I split by primary product type/function rather than theme or material, and assigned the wall tidies/organisers to their own subcategory.
